description: This file defines utility functions for generating unique identifiers, including a private helper function randSegment and a public function newId that combines timestamp-based and random segments to produce a unique ID.

methods.name: randSegment()
methods.description: Generates a short random string segment using Math.random() converted to base 36, slicing characters to produce a 6-character string.

methods.name: newId()
methods.description: Generates a compact unique ID by combining the current timestamp (converted to base 36) with a random segment separated by a hyphen.
